% Pattern: env/declaretheorem/article. Keys name, numberwithin and sibling.
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1.2
% want defn-1 definition -
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm,thmtools}
\declaretheorem[name=Theorem,numberwithin=section]{thm}
\declaretheorem[name=Lemma,sibling=thm]{lem}
\declaretheorem[name=Definition,numbered=no]{defn}
\begin{document}
\section{Start}
\begin{thm}
First.
\end{thm}
\begin{lem}
Second.
\end{lem}
\begin{defn}
A word.
\end{defn}
\end{document}
